question: What claim about the uniqueness of this knowledge is at stake in asserting that nothing equal to it will ever exist again?
premises: Knowledge equal to this knowledge is posited as a possible object.
Such knowledge will not exist again.
Such knowledge does not exist now in an equal form.
inference: This knowledge is presented as unique, with nothing equal to it past or future.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this, nor will there be again.
